headline: Broadcom (AVGO) Lands At The Center Of A $35 Billion AI Financing Trade
summary: Wall Street banks have begun trading pieces of a $35b financing package tied to Broadcom and Anthropic's AI chip and infrastructure build out. The transactions involve buying and selling segments of the funding that supports Anthropic's custom chip orders with Broadcom. This activity signals fresh interest in financing structures linked to large scale AI hardware projects. For investors tracking Broadcom (NasdaqGS:AVGO), this financing package trading activity comes as the stock changes...
